info.name: PorSca API v1
info.description: Repeatable backend contract checks. Run against a freshly seeded local or staging API. Never commit real tokens or webhook secrets.

exec: // P1 env guard: fail fast on placeholder secrets or missing credentials before any stateful request fires.
function isPlaceholder(v) { return !v || v.indexOf('<set-from') !== -1 || v.indexOf('<stable-') !== -1 || v.indexOf('CHANGE_ME') !== -1; }
function haltRun() { postman.setNextRequest(null); if (pm.execution && typeof pm.execution.skipRequest === 'function') { pm.execution.skipRequest(); } }

pm.test('env guard: admin_password, cashier_password and webhook_secret must be real values, not placeholders', function () { throw new Error('Refusing to run with placeholder admin_password/cashier_password/webhook_secret. See docs/TESTING.md.'); });
} else if (name !== 'Auth - Login as admin' && name !== 'Health' && !token) {
pm.test('env guard: missing auth token before stateful requests', function () { throw new Error('No auth token captured from login; refusing stateful request ' + name + '.'); });

pm.test('health environment gate: ok status on the expected target', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(data.database).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(data.environment).to.eql(pm.environment.get('expected_environment')); pm.expect(data.paymongo_mode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('expected_paymongo_mode')); });
// Fail the whole run on environment/database/mode mismatch so a dev-vs-staging mixup stops here with zero stateful side effects.

gateOk = pm.response.code === 200 && data.status === 'ok' && data.database === 'ok' && data.environment === pm.environment.get('expected_environment') && data.paymongo_mode === pm.environment.get('expected_paymongo_mode');

pm.test('login returns an admin bearer token', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(data.token_type).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(data.user.role).to.eql('admin'); pm.environment.set('token', data.token); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/auth/login', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: pm.environment.get('cashier_email'), password: pm.environment.get('cashier_password'), device_name: 'Postman' }) } }, function (err, res) { if (!err && res && res.code === 200 && res.json().data && res.json().data.token) { pm.environment.set('cashier_token', res.json().data.token); } });
pm.test('invalid credentials are rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('unauthorized'); });
pm.test('missing bearer token is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('unauthorized'); });
// P1 repeatability: unique managed-product barcode per run so reruns never hit the 422 unique cliff.

pm.test('product is created with authoritative stock', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.name).to.eql('Postman Managed Product'); pm.expect(data.barcode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('managed_product_barcode')); pm.expect(data.category).to.eql('Beverage'); pm.expect(data.stock.quantity).to.eql(8); pm.expect(data.stock.status).to.eql('in_stock'); pm.environment.set('managed_product_id', data.id); });

pm.test('product edit returns authoritative state', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.name).to.eql('Postman Managed Product XL'); pm.expect(data.barcode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('managed_product_barcode_edit')); pm.expect(data.price).to.eql(19900); pm.expect(data.stock.quantity).to.eql(11); });

pm.test('stock update returns authoritative state', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.stock.quantity).to.eql(9); pm.expect(data.stock.status).to.eql('in_stock'); pm.environment.set('managed_stock_before_sale', data.stock.quantity); });

pm.test('invalid product fields return validation errors', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('validation_error'); pm.expect(error.details).to.have.property('name'); pm.expect(error.details).to.have.property('barcode'); pm.expect(error.details).to.have.property('price'); pm.expect(error.details).to.have.property('stock'); });

pm.test('cash sale completes from server totals', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(data.payment_method).to.eql('cash'); pm.expect(data.total_amount).to.eql(39800); pm.expect(data.cash_received).to.eql(40000); pm.expect(data.change_amount).to.eql(200); pm.expect(data.items[0].unit_price).to.eql(19900); pm.environment.set('cash_sale_id', data.id); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/inventory/' + pm.environment.get('managed_product_id'), method: 'GET', header: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (err, res) { pm.test('completed sale deducts the purchased stock once', function () { pm.expect(err || null).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); const quantity = res.json().data.quantity; pm.expect(quantity).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('managed_stock_before_sale')) - 2); pm.environment.set('cash_sale_stock_after', quantity); }); });

pm.test('cash sale retry is idempotent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_id'))); pm.expect(data.total_amount).to.eql(39800); pm.expect(data.change_amount).to.eql(200); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/inventory/' + pm.environment.get('managed_product_id'), method: 'GET', header: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (err, res) { pm.test('idempotent retry does not deduct stock again', function () { pm.expect(err || null).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(res.json().data.quantity).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_stock_after'))); }); });

pm.test('insufficient stock is rejected without a sale', function () { pm.expect([409, 422]).to.include(pm.response.code); const error = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(error.code).to.eql('insufficient_stock'); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/inventory/' + pm.environment.get('managed_product_id'), method: 'GET', header: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (err, res) { pm.test('stock-short sale leaves inventory unchanged', function () { pm.expect(err || null).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(res.json().data.quantity).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_stock_after'))); }); });

pm.test('completed cash sale is queryable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_id'))); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(data.payment_method).to.eql('cash'); pm.expect(data.items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(data.total_amount).to.eql(39800); pm.expect(data.cash_received).to.eql(40000); pm.expect(data.change_amount).to.eql(200); pm.expect(data.change_amount).to.eql(data.cash_received - data.total_amount); });

pm.test('cashier cannot manage the catalog', function () { pm.expect(pm.environment.get('cashier_token'), 'cashier login via cashier_email/cashier_password').to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.response.to.have.status(403); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('forbidden'); });

item.name: Sales - Cash below total is rejected

exec: pm.test('insufficient cash is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); const err = pm.response.json().error; pm.expect(err.code).to.eql('insufficient_cash'); pm.expect(err.details).to.have.property('cash_received'); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/inventory/' + pm.environment.get('managed_product_id'), method: 'GET', header: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (err, res) { pm.test('rejected sale leaves managed stock at 7', function () { pm.expect(err || null).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(res.json().data.quantity).to.eql(7); }); });
pm.test('unknown product is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(422); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('validation_error'); });

pm.test('products are returned with stock state', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(items[0]).to.have.property('barcode'); pm.expect(items[0].stock).to.have.property('status'); });

pm.expect(rice, 'seeded rice product').to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(coffee, 'seeded coffee product').to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(soap, 'seeded soap product').to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(water, 'seeded water product').to.not.be.undefined;

pm.test('seeded catalog prices are pinned', function () { pm.expect(rice.price).to.eql(32000); pm.expect(coffee.price).to.eql(18500); pm.expect(soap.price).to.eql(7500); pm.expect(water.price).to.eql(3500); });

pm.test('name search finds coffee', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(items[0].name).to.contain('Coffee'); });

pm.test('name search with no matches returns an empty result', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(data.items.length).to.eql(0); pm.expect(data.pagination.total).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('barcode lookup returns product', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.sku).to.eql('RICE-001'); pm.expect(data.barcode).to.eql(pm.environment.get('product_barcode')); });
pm.test('unknown barcode is explicit', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.code).to.eql('not_found'); });

pm.test('inventory filter returns low and out states', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.some(function (item) { return item.status === 'low_stock' && item.low_stock === true; })).to.eql(true); pm.expect(items.some(function (item) { return item.status === 'out_of_stock' && item.out_of_stock === true && item.quantity === 0; })).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('out-of-stock lookup is consistent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.quantity).to.eql(0); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('out_of_stock'); pm.expect(data.out_of_stock).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Sales - Checkout (creates QR Ph practice payment)

exec: pm.test('payment can be read', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.id).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('payment_id'))); });

const body = { data: { id: 'evt-postman-' + Date.now(), type: 'event', attributes: { type: 'payment.paid', livemode: false, data: { id: pm.environment.get('provider_payment_id'), type: 'payment', attributes: { payment_intent_id: pm.environment.get('provider_payment_id'), status: 'paid', livemode: false } } } } };

pm.test('practice fixture cannot be marked paid by webhook', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.sale_id).to.be.null; });
pm.test('invalid webhook signature is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

pm.test('unconfirmed practice webhook remains retryable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.payment.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.duplicate).to.eql(false); });

pm.test('failed-state payment starts pending', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.environment.set('failed_payment_id', pm.response.json().data.id); pm.environment.set('failed_provider_payment_id', pm.response.json().data.provider_payment_id); });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/inventory/' + pm.environment.get('product_id'), method: 'GET', header: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (err, res) { pm.test('failed payment stock baseline is readable', function () { pm.expect(err || null).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); pm.environment.set('failed_webhook_stock_before', res.json().data.quantity); }); });

const body = { data: { id: 'evt-postman-failed-' + Date.now(), type: 'event', attributes: { type: 'payment.failed', livemode: false, data: { id: pm.environment.get('failed_provider_payment_id'), type: 'payment', attributes: { payment_intent_id: pm.environment.get('failed_provider_payment_id'), status: 'failed', livemode: false } } } } };

pm.test('failed webhook is non-destructive', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const data = pm.response.json().data.payment; pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('pending'); pm.expect(data.sale_id).to.be.null; });

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.environment.get('base_url') + '/inventory/' + pm.environment.get('product_id'), method: 'GET', header: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + pm.environment.get('token') } }, function (err, res) { pm.test('failed webhook leaves stock unchanged', function () { pm.expect(err || null).to.be.null; pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(200); pm.expect(res.json().data.quantity).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('failed_webhook_stock_before'))); }); });
pm.test('practice payment stays pending', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('pending'); });

pm.test('sales history includes completed sales', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(items.some(function (item) { return item.id === Number(pm.environment.get('cash_sale_id')) && item.status === 'completed'; })).to.eql(true); const cashSales = items.filter(function (item) { return item.payment_method === 'cash' && item.status === 'completed'; }); pm.expect(cashSales.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(cashSales[0].total_amount).to.eql(39800); pm.expect(cashSales[0].change_amount).to.eql(cashSales[0].cash_received - cashSales[0].total_amount); });

pm.test('practice payment ledger holds only its creation entry', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(items[0].type).to.eql('payment_created'); pm.expect(items[0].status).to.eql('pending'); });

pm.test('cash sale ledger is queryable', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const items = pm.response.json().data.items; pm.expect(items.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(items[0].type).to.eql('cash_sale'); pm.expect(items[0].status).to.eql('completed'); pm.expect(items[0].amount).to.eql(39800); });
